name: CIS Benchmark — Cisco IOS
description: Center for Internet Security (CIS) Benchmark for Cisco IOS. Covers authentication, access control, logging, and hardening best practices.

rules.name: Enable secret required
rules.description: An enable secret must be configured using scrypt or SHA-256 hashing

rules.name: No enable password
rules.description: The weak 'enable password' command must not be used — use 'enable secret' instead

rules.name: Service password encryption
rules.description: Password encryption service must be enabled to prevent plaintext password display

rules.name: AAA new-model
rules.description: AAA authentication must be enabled for centralized access control

rules.name: No telnet on VTY lines
rules.description: Telnet must be disabled on all VTY lines — SSH only

rules.name: NTP server configured
rules.description: At least one NTP server must be configured for accurate timestamps

rules.name: Logging enabled
rules.description: Syslog logging must be configured to a remote server

rules.name: Service timestamps
rules.description: Timestamps must be enabled on log and debug messages

rules.name: No IP source routing
rules.description: IP source routing must be disabled to prevent route injection attacks

rules.name: Banner login
rules.description: A login banner must be configured for legal notice

rules.name: No SNMP default communities
rules.description: Default SNMP community strings 'public' and 'private' must not be used

rules.name: SSH version 2
rules.description: SSH version 2 must be explicitly configured (SSHv1 has known vulnerabilities)

rules.name: Trunk interfaces must have storm-control
rules.description: Every trunk interface must have storm-control configured to prevent broadcast storms

rules.name: VTY access-class required
rules.description: VTY lines must have an access-class applied to restrict management access
